implement: skill://legion-worker — the only skills that reach this repository (no AGENTS.md, no repository skills); its references/pr-body.md gives the PR template, the proof shape and the docs-only rule (no simplify pass, no Thermo line), references/default-branch-check.md the identity check before each push, references/review-threads.md the one-reply-one-resolution rule; skill://legion-retro drives the retro phase the implementer runs
test: skill://legion-worker — references/pr-body.md defines verifying the implementer's proof and the tester's own proof on the GitHub repository surface (no suite, lint or runtime exists to rerun), references/merge-gate.md defines reading CI at the CI head rather than at a trailered handoff head
review: skill://legion-worker — references/merge-gate.md gives the required-set read (rules/branches/main → gate), the CI-head read and approval of the head; references/review-threads.md gives the review-thread protocol the conditional second-line request must follow

constants.secondLineDiscriminator: gh pr view <n> -R sjawhar/legion-smoke --json reviews --jq '[.reviews[] | select(.state=="CHANGES_REQUESTED") | select((.body // "") | test("append one more line"))] | length'

acceptance.criterion: main holds a new smoke/LEGSMOKE-1044.md that no earlier main commit contains
acceptance.check: commits?path=smoke/LEGSMOKE-1044.md&sha=main → 0 before the first code push; [<mergeSha>] after the merge; contents?ref=main 404 before, 200 after

acceptance.criterion: At the first push carrying the file (firstCodeHead) it holds exactly one LF-terminated line naming this issue
acceptance.check: readCommand at firstCodeHead: sha256 lineOneSha256, wc -c 85, wc -l 1, last byte 0a, grep -c '^LEGSMOKE-1044: ' 1

acceptance.criterion: Two lines only when a review asked (secondLineDiscriminator > 0); line 1 unchanged
acceptance.check: count > 0 ⇒ at the append head and later: wc -l 2, wc -c 124 (default) or the recorded value, head -1 = line 1 at firstCodeHead; count = 0 ⇒ lineOne constants at every code head through the merge

acceptance.criterion: Nothing else changes: branch paths ⊆ allowedPaths; merge diff = marker + zero or one retro note; merge commit has one parent
acceptance.check: jj diff --from 'fork_point(main@origin | @-)' --to @- --name-only before each push; compare/<forkPoint>...<sha> at firstCodeHead and at the READY head; commits/<mergeSha> parents 1

acceptance.criterion: Both workflows (check, gate) pass at every code head, the READY head included
acceptance.check: commits/<sha>/check-runs: check and gate every entry completed/success (two entries per job with an open PR)

acceptance.criterion: After the merge, main holds the selected lines
acceptance.check: readCommand at <mergeSha> and at main matches the selected constants; the same read at the merge commit's first parent → 404

findings.finding: No criterion is bound to a head; after an append the one-line constants are false at later heads.
findings.answer: D5/A2/A3: C1 read at firstCodeHead and held only while the discriminator count is 0; C2 at the append head and later; C-final at the merge commit; nobody re-reads C1 after an append.

findings.finding: The conditional second line has no discriminator and no text; precedent is the literal 'Legion proof review round 1 (LEGSMOKE)'.
findings.answer: D3 fixes the request shape (CHANGES_REQUESTED body containing 'append one more line' + one thread on the file); D2 fixes the default text, its 124-byte/sha constants, and the recompute procedure for a review-named text.

findings.finding: 'Nothing else changes' contradicts Legion's own .legion/ handoffs and retro's docs/solutions/ note.
findings.answer: D10/A4: allowed-path set named; 'nothing else changes' defined as the merge diff (paths outside .legion/LEGSMOKE-1044/); Size written that way; guard via jj diff from fork_point.

findings.finding: The merge head must carry a green gate; trailered handoff heads have zero check-runs; retro's push rewrites the head after approval.
findings.answer: D8/D13/M1: handoff-only pushes trailered, retro's removal push untrailered so both workflows run, READY names that head after D7 passes there, approval stands on the reviewed head per merge-gate.md.

findings.finding: 'a single line that names this issue' fixes neither filename, string nor bytes; precedent varies on the /tmp suffix; a title edit mid-run would redefine the target.
findings.answer: D1 freezes path, line (title taken whole at planning), 85 bytes, 1 line, 0a, no CR/BOM, and makes plan.json constants.lineOne the authority regardless of later title edits.

findings.finding: The sha256 constants are asserted, not shown.
findings.answer: D1/D2 record the generating command beside each constant and rule that a constant failing regeneration is a plan defect reported to the architect, never a file defect.

findings.finding: No suite, lint or runtime, yet the tester must drive the surface independently and write a red test where none would catch a break.
findings.answer: D12: independent route (JSON .content base64-decoded vs raw), own negative controls, explicit noSuite record (no regression lock owed), tester commits nothing.
D14: production = main at the squash-merge commit, read at <mergeSha> and at main; negative control the merge commit's first parent → 404; waking event named in the Production line.

findings.finding: The PR body template's CI line names lint/typecheck/test; this repo has check and gate.
findings.answer: D7 gives the CI line's exact shape for ci/check and fail-on-demand/gate, cites the pull_request pair and names the push pair, gate blocking and check advisory, wait for completed.

findings.finding: Scope allows 'one more line' with no refusal protocol and no bound on repeats (decider: architect).
findings.answer: D2: cap at one appended line total; out-of-scope requests declined in the thread citing Scope, resolved with that reason, and sent to the architect verbatim; named for the architect in the completion summary.

findings.finding: main@origin equals the fork point today; eight other trees will move main mid-run.
findings.answer: D15/D10: fork_point(main@origin | @-) everywhere, recorded once; pre-state is four invalidating facts with commands; stop condition 'one of these changed'; no --from main@origin anywhere.

findings.finding: No root .gitignore and jj auto-tracks everything; body.md written in the tree or .codegraph/ artefacts would be snapshotted.
findings.answer: D10: scratch files under /tmp only; pre-push guard lists exactly the allowed set; stray path removed or untracked before push. .codegraph/ observed untracked and excluded by the clone's .git/info/exclude.

findings.finding: The PR body has repo-specific fields the spec never mentions (Dispatch line, Thermo, Look at first, Not proven / risk, Fast-follow, Chain).
findings.answer: D11 pins every line's value and the phase that writes it; Thermo omitted (docs-only).

findings.finding: Retro 'zero or more notes' with three notes already covering this pattern.
findings.answer: D6: default zero notes; search on main named; a note only for a lesson none records; Size refreshed at the removal head if one is written.

findings.finding: The title's 'Upgrade rehearsal fallback' asserts a context the spec never explains (decider: architect).
findings.answer: D17: every constant lives in plan.json/implement.json so a resumed phase recomputes nothing from memory; the scenario is taken to change nothing about the file or checks; named for the architect in the completion summary.

findings.finding: Every live-state fact is unverified by the analyst and several move on their own.
findings.answer: 'What was read' carries each fact with its re-reading command and timestamp as pre-state; D15 says which ones stop the run.

findings.finding: 'od present, xxd absent' and 'auto-track = all()' are inherited claims.
findings.answer: Both observed in the planner pane (command -v od/xxd; jj config get snapshot.auto-track) and recorded as observed in 'What was read'.

findings.finding: The 1022 plan precedent is a summary the analyst could not check; its SHAs, constants, Size numbers and discriminator wording must not be copied.
findings.answer: The 1022 plan was re-read in full; decisions carry over as patterns only, every constant re-derived for LEGSMOKE-1044 ('What was read').
